brief:
Palestinian women in Gaza are creating films to document their experiences and stories emerging from the territory's destruction, the Middle East Eye reported. Mai Masri, a filmmaker, remotely taught 25 students at the Gaza Cinema Academy from Beirut using laptop instruction, enabling the production work despite the conflict's constraints.

The initiative represents an effort by Palestinian women to reclaim narrative control and preserve accounts of life in Gaza through cinema as the region faces ongoing humanitarian challenges.
dek: From Gaza's ruins, Palestinian women are rising to tell their stories on film Submitted by Hamid Dabashi on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 15:25 Mai Masri taught the Gaza Cinema Academy's 25 filmmakers by laptop from Beirut.
title: Palestinian women filmmakers document Gaza through war's aftermath
